publisher.name: Unlikelyware
publisher.support: GitHub Issues in each product's repo

StageHand.tagline: Live-performance host for CLAP plugins, with MIDI 1.0 and MIDI 2.0 both first-class

KeyboardEDO.tagline: On-screen MIDI 2.0 keyboard for any equal division of the octave

PlainOldSynth.tagline: Classic subtractive synth: one stereo-detuned oscillator, 24 dB low-pass, two ADSRs, two LFOs

StruckSynth.tagline: Modal-synthesis instrument: a shaped strike into a bank of tuned resonators

StruckRoom.tagline: A struck instrument inside a room that scales with the note: somewhere between an instrument and a reverb

StruckGaussian.tagline: A struck object whose modes are a Gaussian cloud around the note: from a chorus on one pitch to a wide clang

StruckKit.tagline: Modal-synthesis drum kit, a whole kit from one instance

IFSynth.tagline: Fractal synth: oscillator, envelopes and LFOs shaped by IFS fractals you draw

Retune.tagline: Transposes every note by a fixed interval in any equal division of the octave

NoteGran.tagline: Granular synthesis with notes as the grains: Cloud, Chords, Grid, Burst and Buffer

EDOSpread12.tagline: Plays any equal division of the octave from an ordinary 12-key keyboard, each key on the step you give it
